# wifi-ap-start bench frames (SYNTHETIC)

Generated by tools/gen_frames_md.py from the host selftest emitter; do not
edit by hand.  Every vector is synthesized from the field tables in
../REPORT.md / ../TABLES.md - it is NOT a vendor capture and contains no
vendor byte.  Byte order in the hex dumps is wire order.  Reproduce with:

```
./tools/build.sh && /tmp/wifi-ap-start-build/ap_frames_selftest --emit
```
